sources.risk_free_rate: India 10-Year Government Bond historical yield - countryeconomy.com
sources.equity_risk_premium: Aswath Damodaran - Country Risk Premiums, India
sources.beta: Aswath Damodaran - Betas by Sector (Global), Furn/Home Furnishings
sources.cost_of_debt: Derived from extracted audited financial statements
sources.capital_weights: Derived from valuation-date extracted balance sheet

basis.risk_free_rate: 10-year India Government Bond yield on the valuation date or nearest prior available trading date.
basis.equity_risk_premium: India total equity risk premium reference. Valuer should use the dataset vintage appropriate to the valuation date.
basis.beta: Global industry levered beta for Furn/Home Furnishings. Valuer should assess whether a bottom-up/relevered beta is more appropriate for the subject company.
basis.cost_of_debt: Latest finance cost 290.0 divided by average total debt 2065.0. This is an accounting implied rate, not automatically the marginal borrowing rate; valuer review is required.
basis.capital_weights: Net worth 4538.0 and total debt 2260.0; book-value capital weights are a suggestion only. Valuer may replace with market-value / target weights.

warnings: Suggested pre-tax cost of debt is an accounting implied rate; replace it with the current marginal borrowing rate when available.
Capital weights are book-value based suggestions. Use market-value / target weights where appropriate.
Company-specific risk premium is defaulted to 0.00%; this is a valuer judgement input, not an automated market-data fact.
